intro:
Every day, we have to take on a lot. Work, groceries, family, and sports – each part of our routine is important, but it also puts a lot of stress on us, even when we love it. For your body to function properly, it is important to rest. Recovery is a mandatory part of your day-to-day life. Researchers published a review and meta-analysis in Frontiers in Physiology that examined the effects of recovery methods on the body post-workout. Methods of recovery, including massage, cold therapy, compression and others found to decrease levels of inflammation, muscle pain, and fatigue.

As you can see, this part of your routine is just as important as the workout. Therefore, in this article, we will talk about various biohacking recovery methods. Our experts analysed options ranging from classic ones, such as sauna and massage, to more experimental methods, like the peptide therapy. We discuss what will be beneficial for your mind and body, and also find out which useful supplements can support your mental state.
highlights: Biohackers use different recovery and relaxation methods.
For physical recovery the most popular methods include red light therapy, sauna, cold exposure and massage.
For mental recovery and stress management people use breathwork, meditation, yoga and sound therapy.
Some advanced methods mentioned in the article require medical consultation before use.

blocks.text: What Is Biohacking Recovery

We are used to thinking that lying in bed or having a barbecue are the only ways to rest after a difficult work week. But the biohacking world offers a much wider range than this. This method helps to restore the body through a combination of modern technologies, natural methods, and science. Thanks to the [biohacking approach](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/what-is-biohacking), the recovery of your body will be more complete and effective. It will give you more strength and charge you with energy for the upcoming week.

Disclaimer! The article describes recovery methods for healthy people without serious injuries and chronic diseases. If you have any of the above, consult a specialist before using these methods. Do not use these methods for self-treatment!
Biohacking Recovery Methods

There are quite a lot of options for body recovery. Each of them is aimed at a specific effect and helps you in different ways. It is important to choose the option that will bring you not only benefits but also joy. This way you will be able to introduce it into your routine and not abandon it. Let’s have a look at the most popular ones.
Red Light Therapy

This therapy is useful for [biohacking muscle](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/how-to-strengthen-muscle-growth-using-biohacking-methods) recovery. It is based on the impact of certain wavelengths on the body’s tissues. For [red light therapy](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/red-light-therapy-biohacking-methods-for-health-benefits), LED panels or portable devices are used. They direct light onto the skin and muscles.It penetrates tissues, at a wavelength of 630-850 nm, to alter the cellular powerhouses (mitochondria) to increase energy production for the cell.

That option is particularly useful for athletes wanting to discover the recovery of sore muscles post-workout. Also, it’s worth mentioning an [anti-ageing](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/how-biohacking-can-reverse-aging) effect on the skin as well. With this recovery therapy, there is the added benefit of collagen production along with a therapeutic and restorative mechanism of microcirculation and cellular regeneration.
Infrared Sauna Therapy

One of the most comfortable recovery methods is the infrared sauna. The difference between it and a classic one is that the heat radiation penetrates deeper, and muscle relaxation becomes more noticeable. It is also suitable for people who cannot tolerate the high temperatures of Finnish and Roman saunas. For this, special cabins with infrared panels are used, which heat the body deeply and directly rather than the air.

Infrared sauna is suitable for athletes’ muscle relaxation and improving blood circulation. It also helps the release of metabolism through sweat. Such a sauna is suitable for those who train regularly, as well as those who experience a lot of stress at work.
Cold Therapy

Possibly your first thought on your mind is that it’s too extreme. But at the same time, it brings many benefits to your body and mental performance. It includes cryo chambers, cold showers, or ice baths. Due to the sharp narrowing of blood vessels and their expansion afterwards, blood microcirculation improves. The skin also becomes firmer and more toned.

This therapy is also particularly useful for the reduction of sore muscles, post-workout recovery, and the decrease of inflammation along with an increase of stress and pain relief. Also, [cold therapy](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/cold-water-therapy) is helpful in the production of norepinephrine which aids in the improvement of overall condition and energy levels. An added benefit of cold therapy is the recovery of calm and concentration.
Compression and Massage Therapy

Both options are aimed at a direct impact on the muscles. With compression, you create additional pressure on them, and due to this, relaxation occurs. These can be special sleeves or boots with such an effect. Speaking about [massage](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/massage-therapy), you can choose manual or the machine one. Each of them has its own benefit. When a specialist performs a massage, they know which area is better to work on, where the body feels tighter, and where less effort should be applied. When you massage with a special roller or gun, it is always at hand. But you may not distribute the pressure of the device correctly or you may not reach the necessary parts of the body on your own. Therefore, it is better to combine both techniques.

Both massage and compression recovery techniques help improve lymph flow and blood circulation. It works well for muscle recovery and can also help with inflammation. If you lead a sedentary lifestyle and your work routine involves a computer, this option will help you maintain a healthy back and joints.
Vibration Therapy

There are several types of [vibration therapy](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/body-vibration-therapy-for-biohackers): general in the form of vibration platforms and local, which is carried out using percussion massagers or a vibration couch. This method uses mechanical oscillations of low frequency. It affects positively on joints, muscles, and fascia. Procedures are especially useful after injuries and accelerate the rehabilitation of the body.

It removes muscle pain, helps with osteochondrosis and diseases of the peripheral system. The vibrations activate muscle fibres and stimulate blood circulation. It could be especially useful after immobilisation of joints. Vibration therapy reduces cortisol levels and improves tissue atrophy.
PEMF Therapy

This option uses specific devices that create low-frequency electromagnetic impulses. Usually, these are mats, pillows, or portable devices that affect the body. It is believed that such impulses influence cellular processes and improve metabolism. If you need to reduce stress level or chronic fatigue [PEMF therapy](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/pemf-therapy-for-biohacking) might be your option. As it contributes to the renewal by stimulating boosts the production of Adenosine Triphosphate (ATP). Which is the primary energy source for cells. It allows them to repair and function more efficiently. It also helps to adjust the sleep cycle and cope with inflammation.
Acupuncture

This method may not immediately come to mind when talking about relaxation. But in fact, [acupuncture](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/biohacking-acupuncture) is an ancient and traditional method of fighting not only fatigue but also various diseases, originating from ancient China. The main thing is that the procedure is performed by a real specialist who understands what they are doing.

The idea of acupuncture is to influence energy channels. Manipulations are carried out using thin needles that are inserted under the skin at specific points. This technique is widely used; it can help cope with muscle tension, restore the balance of the body and its processes as a whole. It is suitable for those who are looking for traditional methods tested over centuries. If you find the right specialist, it can become your favourite procedure, as many people feel a clearer mind and improved concentration after it.
EWOT (Exercise With Oxygen Therapy)

This active recovery method combines physical activity and improved oxygenation of the body. For this, a special mask and backpack are worn. They help supply additional oxygen during workouts. This helps improve tissue oxygen saturation, increase endurance, and speed up recovery. The method is especially useful for people who engage in sports or seek to increase energy levels. It can also contribute to improving the functioning of the cardiovascular system.

Electrical Muscle Stimulation

These are small impulses of electricity that are passed through electrodes to the muscles. There is no need to be afraid of this option, as the impulses are quite comfortable for the body. [Electrical stimulation](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/electrical-muscle-stimulation) helps relax muscles after exhausting workouts, so it may be useful for professional athletes. It is also useful in rehabilitation and serves as a prevention of muscle atrophy. Such stimulation helps maintain the tone of deep muscle layers and therefore will also be useful for people with low physical activity, as the body will maintain flexibility and energy even if you skipped a couple of workouts.
Peptide Therapy

First, let’s explain what peptides are. These are short chains of amino acids that already exist in our body, but also participate in its regeneration and rejuvenation. In addition, peptides help in the recovery of muscle tissues. These unusual advanced recovery techniques use peptides directly into the body. Usually, the method involves injections, so it is important that it is carried out by a specialist. Peptide therapy can contribute to an anti-ageing effect, recovery of muscle tissues, and support hormonal balance.
However, it is important to consider that this approach requires individual selection and medical supervision.
Mind-Body Recovery Techniques

We have discussed practices that you can do once or twice a week, but what about the rest of the time? After all, every day we face stress. That is why it is important to support yourself throughout the entire period, not just occasionally. Only discipline gives long-term results. Let’s explore several recovery techniques that you can apply regardless of external factors and for free.
Breathwork

Sometimes the secret lies not in something complex, but in a simple change in breathing. Try not to breathe actively with your chest but focus on the work of your abdomen. It should fully participate in [breathing](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/breathwork-biohacking). As kundalini yoga claims, this is where our energy centre is located, and such breathing helps [reduce stress levels](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/biohacking-for-stress-management-what-about-mental-health). You can also try special breathing exercises.

One common technique is the Wim Hof method. It includes 4 rounds consisting of 30 deep inhales and exhales, while you should hold your breath on the exhale. Try to continue the technique for about 1-2 minutes. This will allow you to reduce stress and get an additional boost of energy. You can also try box breathing. It requires counting to four on inhale, exhale, and pauses between them.
Meditation

This energy healing method is useful for [meditation](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/biohacking-meditation) which is also helpful for the improvement of neural connections. Creativity is an essential part of brain activity which is developed by practising meditation. It is as simple as lying on a mat, and in a comfortable position, closing the eyes, relaxing to a point with concentration on the natural or pleasant mental association, and then acting on a determined mental picture followed by a natural deep breath. For sustained emotional correction and optimal cognitive recovery, meditation should be performed consistently.
Yoga

One of the most ancient relaxation practices is [yoga](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/biohackers-guide-to-yoga). In essence, yoga is gymnastics that helps improve joint function and flexibility. It combines physical activity, breathing, and meditation. Yoga helps restore the balance of your mental and physical state and remove excess tension from the body.

If you are a complete beginner, try hatha yoga, it is suitable for getting acquainted with the basic techniques of the yogic system. After that, you can start exploring other branches: yin yoga or yoga nidra. Both of these techniques work to reduce cortisol and disconnect from external noise. The main advantages of yoga are additional flexibility, improved mental health, and normalisation of the nervous system. Yoga also has no age restrictions, it is suitable even for elderly people.
Grounding (Earthing)

This is the name given to the technique in which you walk barefoot on the ground. It is believed that this helps restore internal balance through connection with nature. This has a positive effect on the nervous system and increases oxytocin levels. [Grounding](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/grounding-biohacking-practice) is especially useful on sunny days when you can also get an additional vitamin D boost.

Types of this practice include walking barefoot on grass, sand, or soil, lying on the ground, and using grounding mats. Benefits include reduced stress levels, improved sleep, reduced inflammation, and overall relaxation of the body. Especially for people living in urban environments.
Sound Therapy

[Sound](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/sound-therapy-in-biohacking) is one of the strongest ways of influencing our consciousness. It is a factor that can either relax the body or put it into a state of stress. This is achieved through certain frequencies. For example, frequencies of 432 Hz and 528 Hz help during meditation. Such sounds have a beneficial effect on the brain and develop creativity. You can also try sound healing sessions with singing bowls and gongs. They affect the whole body and contribute to muscle relaxation.
Supplements That Support Recovery

[Supplements](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/best-biohacking-supplements) can serve as an additional tool to support the recovery of the body, especially under high loads or chronic stress. Although they cannot replace other recovery methods, they can still help support your daily routine. These supplements work by supporting internal processes rather than through an instant effect, so regular use is important. The most effective include:

items: Magnesium. One of the most popular supplements at the moment. It helps relax muscles and improve sleep quality. If you experience nervous tension, excess stress, or problems with circadian rhythms, magnesium can improve your condition.
Omega-3 fatty acids. Help support cell health and have an anti-inflammatory effect. Omega-3 also affects brain function and the cardiovascular system.
Collagen. Contributes to the recovery of tissues, joints, and skin. Especially relevant during physical activities and age-related changes.
Ashwagandha. An adaptogen that helps reduce cortisol levels and improve stress resistance. It can also positively affect sleep and concentration.
Vitamin D. Plays an important role in the immune system and overall condition of the body, especially with a lack of sunlight.

blocks.text: Who Can Benefit from Biohacking Recovery

Now that we have discussed different biohacking recovery options, let’s talk about who this type of recovery is suitable for. It should not be limited to professional athletes or people who understand biohacking. Almost anyone can benefit from this approach. The only important condition is to consult your doctor before starting any new practice and make sure your health allows the chosen technique. Let’s look at who will definitely benefit:

items: Athletes. Since athletes have a lot of physical activity in their lives, they need to incorporate recovery into their workout routine. This helps improve existing results and overall body condition, as well as address weak areas such as joints.

Biohackers. Of course, this is one of the main groups, as they like to experiment and improve their bodies. The techniques described above will help a biohacker better understand their body and optimise its functioning.

People with high stress levels. If your work involves a lot of responsibility, there will be enough stress regardless of your desire. To maintain concentration and improve performance, you need to include recovery days. They will help reduce the load on the nervous system, improve sleep, and overall well-being.

blocks.text: Summary

Biohacking technologies are developing more and more every day, and this gives the opportunity to better understand your body. We discussed the best recovery techniques that will help you cope with the stress of modern life. They include both procedures such as massage and acupuncture, and simpler techniques such as meditation. Now you are also aware about supplements that will help you maintain calmness and concentration.
And a few useful tips to sum everything up:

items: Start with basic methods: sleep, breathing, and stress reduction.
Add technologies gradually, tracking your body’s response.
Do not use all methods at once. The best way to teach yourself is to have one but put it into the routine.
Be consistent, as it is more important than intensity.
Remember about your individual body state so include it in terms of trying new options.
If necessary, consult an expert before using any recovery methods.
